title: s500-literature-171: Working-memory gating task iEEG, epoched bipolar ECoG/sEEG from 11 patients with Yeo-7 network labels (Johnson et al., 2023) (derivative)
description: Epoched, bipolar-referenced intracranial EEG (ECoG/sEEG) from 11 neurosurgical epilepsy patients performing a single-trial working-memory gating task with context-first and context-last conditions. The derivative release repackages the authors' filtered, artifact-cleaned FieldTrip epochs into BIDS, with trial-level behavioral information, electrode positions and Yeo-7 network labels where mappable. It supports analysis of theta network mechanisms of flexible information encoding.
methods_description: Preprocessed bipolar iEEG epochs released by the authors on OSF were converted from FieldTrip structs to BrainVision float32 format, with trialinfo fields written as events and chanpos as electrode coordinates. Channel types were inferred from bipolar pair numbering following the article's montage rule.
